name: Blobe
subtitle: Post on the globe
description:
Blobe lets you place posts anywhere on Earth and discover what people are sharing around you — or anywhere in the world. Zoom into any location, read posts pinned to the globe, vote on what's worth seeing, and chat directly with other users. Creators can run location-based campaigns and earn from their audience.

Features:
• Place geo-tagged posts on a 3D globe
• Real-time community trust voting
• End-to-end encrypted direct messages
• Location-based creator campaigns with Stripe payouts
• Privacy-first: delete your account and all data at any time
